title: Anybody been here?
content: I went here last night for the first time I think. It looked kind of like this but there was a lot more rock than greenery and it was kind of enclosed with all that cliff rock around it but also the sea was one side and all the water near the house was natural springs. There also was a large darker stone building kind of like a church or temple and there was loads of volcanic rock in the distance. I think I asked someone I was with where I was and they said something about the Lebanon. I've never been to the Lebanon and honestly have no idea why I would have dreamed about there. Has anyone else been here?
